title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of United Community Bank
full_text:
November 12, 2026
Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of United Community Bank
For release at 11:00 a.m. EST
Share
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced the execution of the enforcement action listed below:
Consent prohibition against Katilyn M. Robinson
Former employee of United Community Bank, Greenville, South Carolina
Misappropriation of customer funds
